idea-plugin.name: Expand Cursor
idea-plugin.description:
VSCode-style "expand" caret blinking for JetBrains IDEs.

The caret smoothly collapses into a thin horizontal line at its vertical center and expands back to full height (the same animation as editor.cursorBlinking: expand in VSCode). The animation restarts to full size whenever the caret moves and stays solid while you are typing.

Configure it under Settings | Editor | Expand Cursor, or run the Toggle Expand Cursor action (assign a shortcut via Find Action).

The blink rate follows the IDE "Blinking period" setting. If caret blinking is disabled in the IDE, the plugin stays idle.

action.description: Toggles the VSCode-style expand caret animation.
